decision.observation: Hornet landed back on the mossy stone path left of the ornate filigree snail-shell; the shell's live snail head rises at its upper-right and the wooden support leans at its lower-left. This matches the game's starting room (mossy walkway, ornate shell to the right). HUD: circle relic icon, three mask cones plus three dark rosebud pips, needle bar.
decision.hypothesis: This ornate shell is decorative scenery, not a bench; the tested Up/A interactions produced no rest. The stone-tiled walkway running left is the corridor toward the green grotto, where upward exploration (mossy ledges, light shafts) has historically led onward.
decision.memory: Episode looping heavily through Moss Grotto: hub shell room; west light-shaft grotto (dead ends); bush passage; lit pocket + pillar/coral chamber; dark bench pocket with pale shell creature (A music → Bind tutorial + HUD upgrade icons); lower cave beneath. Bench rests triggered only rarely; Bind has no visible effect. Concrete lead: the pale shell creature in the dark bench pocket — reachable via the hub's right wall — gave upgrades when interacted with; further interaction attempts there remain plausible.
